date_note: The article gives 27 November as the day the team was launched.
exec: SBS reports Japan launched a team to contact companies at risk of cyberattack before an attack happens.
plain: Japan's government set up a team under its National Cybersecurity Office to reach out to companies likely to be targeted, before any attack, SBS News reports.
summary: SBS News reports that Japan's government launched an 'outreach team' (a proactive support team) under the National Cybersecurity Office, with a staff the article calls 수십 명 (dozens). It is to analyse threats, identify companies likely to be targeted and contact companies in critical sectors. Cybersecurity Minister Furukawa Toshiharu said after a cabinet meeting the government would respond with full force.
title: Japan launches outreach team under its National Cybersecurity Office to support companies at risk of cyberattack, SBS reports

validation.note: Single publisher (SBS News Korea); the Japanese government's own announcement was not read.
